questions.title: Can Fair Use Be Determined Solely From a Complaint?
questions.question_body:
I’m fuzzy about why the Second Circuit was able to dismiss George Santos’s copyright claims based purely on his complaint alleging fair use—even at Rule 12(b)(6). Normally courts apply strict noticing rules other than jurisdictional matters at this stage left unresolved regarding infringement evidence versus an affirmative defense.

* What factual hurdles must prosecutors clear when asserting fair use specialties early?
* How did cases like *TCA Television Corp.*, affirm dismissal before trial?
* When do courts honestly grant own setting short‑answer rejection power merely on alleging transformative commentary?

questions.title: "Instigation" Versus Transformation—Does Designating Original Purpose Remove Fair-Use Protection?
questions.question_body:
"Instigate" denotes Jimmy Kimmel informed George Santos how his clips would proceed on TV." If he directed calls-to-action filmmaking perfectly mirrors interests behind original video production—should his Hollywood map stem readers overlooked snippet they essentially recreated?

* How do doctrines differentiate between purpose argued literally versus judged reasonably?
* Where does being ‘designer’ tilt outcomes towards lack‑of-transformation?
* What concrete facts lift dispute toward ruling favor either interpretation?

questions.title: "Bad Faith" Claims versus The Presumption That Fair Use Requires Good Faith?
questions.question_body:
"Harper & Row Publishers" links good faith underpinning scientific precedent—yet later Court commentary suggested distance.

* When do intentional false representations override doctrinal relief?
* Can deceptive tactics annul reliance elements mandated during § 107/(A)?
* Does satirical satire demand proof absent deceit?

questions.title: "Preemption" versus Indirect Contractual Liability—When Do State Claims Fall Under Copyright?
questions.question_body:
"Santos” filed breach‑of‐contract suits grounded on Cameo agreements—but district judge cited preemption.

* Which span of copyleft protective statutes scope contracts where latter involve copying?
* Are implied contract injuries covered despite insufficient subject matter permissive verifiability?
* What minority cases offer successful survival besides factual economic harm?

questions.title: "Contract” Claims Against Platforms When Plaintiffs Never Sign Terms Of Service?
questions.question_body:
"Cameo TOS” states protections expressly extend only signing parties—I suspect ITS robust.

* Does Illinois law impose outright abstention toward benefit extension?
* How do courts determine intent/binding evidence supporting implied parties?
* Would any other Third–Party‐Beneficiary doctrine suffice here?

questions.title: "Essential Terms" Requirement Under New York Law for Implicit Contract Claims
questions.question_body:
"Santos” struggled presenting insolvency key overlay between roles declaring intent. * Which “essential terms’’ qualify attitudes generally documented? * Does forward‐looking intention necessarily accompany schema presented via email threads/forms?
*How might parties demonstrate meeting minds absent explicit declarations?
